title: Mortgage Loan File Program Matrix: Loan Amounts, Reserves, Term and Eligible Transactions
content:
For a Mortgage Loan File, each Larkspur program defines the range of base loan amounts it accepts, the post-closing reserves it requires, the amortization term of the note, and the loan purposes, occupancies, unit counts, income limits and homebuyer education requirement it allows.

## Loan size, reserves and term

| Program | Minimum base loan amount (USD) | Maximum base loan amount (USD) | Post-closing reserves (months of the full housing payment) | Note term (months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | 75000.00 | 541287.00 | 0 | 360 |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | 75000.00 | 1500000.00 | 0 | 360 |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | 75000.00 | 832750.00 | 0 | 360 |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | 75000.00 | 832750.00 | 2 | 360 |
| Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed | 75000.00 | 832750.00 | 2 | 180 |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | 832751.00 | 1249125.00 | 6 | 360 |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 832751.00 | 3000000.00 | 12 | 360 |

The minimum and maximum are both inclusive: a base loan amount equal to either end of the range lies within it.

## Eligible transactions

| Program | Eligible loan purposes | Eligible occupancies | Maximum dwelling units | Income limit (percent of area median income) | Homebuyer education certificate for first-time homebuyer files |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | purchase, rate-and-term refinance, cash-out refinance | primary residence | 4 | no limit | not required |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | purchase, rate-and-term refinance, cash-out refinance | primary residence | 4 | no limit | not required |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | purchase, rate-and-term refinance | primary residence | 4 | 80 | required |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | purchase, rate-and-term refinance, cash-out refinance | primary residence, second home, investment property | 4 | no limit | not required |
| Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed | purchase, rate-and-term refinance, cash-out refinance | primary residence, second home, investment property | 4 | no limit | not required |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | purchase, rate-and-term refinance, cash-out refinance | primary residence, second home, investment property | 4 | no limit | not required |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | purchase, rate-and-term refinance, cash-out refinance | primary residence, second home | 2 | no limit | not required |

"No limit" means qualifying income is not tested against area median income for that program.

## Points of reading

- A hypothetical base loan amount of 832750.00 USD is at the top of the Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed range and inside it; 832751.00 USD is the bottom of the Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed range and inside that one.
- A hypothetical three-unit property is within the unit limit of every program except the Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed, whose limit is 2 units.
- Under the Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed program a file whose qualifying income is 80 percent of area median income is within the limit; 81 percent is not.
